summary: John Regan died in a fall on Longs Peak's Keyhole Route
notes: | NPT 2010-09: witnessed fall ~12:30 p.m. Sat Sep 25 from The Ledges by three hikers; rangers reached body 3:17 p.m. Run 782: NPS incident-report archive (npshistory.com ROMO morning reports) entry 'Hiker Falls To His Death On Longs Peak' (report 2010-09-28) confirms 300-ft Keyhole Route fall on 2010-09-25 witnessed by three hikers.
